mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen by more than 0.25 percentage points over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depress corporate earnings growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in labor market conditions (UNRATE > 5.0%) and consumer spending (RSAFS growth < 0.5% MoM) signals a contractionary economic cycle, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and RSAFS growth < 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced real earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months signals weakening labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS has declined by more than 0.5% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.0% from the prior month signals a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) and housing starts (HOUST < 1650.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0 and HOUST < 1650.0.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 1.0% MoM) combined with positive GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to robust corporate earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 1.0% MoM AND GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances where RSAFS growth > 1.0% MoM and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% QoQ.
